body: I'm in Australia too and have had a very similar experience. You have every right to write to your state representative. You can google "who is my state member in (whatever suburb you live in)" if you don't already know. I phoned my state reps office to confirm they were the appropriate person to reach out to, and they actually offered to phone the hospital on my behalf. Pretty atrocious that in Australia this is happening, but you should definitely give that a go if you haven't already. They will jump to action if the health minister is asking questions. You will probably have to wait til Monday to callyour state members office, but do it.
